scope: local-first governed agent promotion criteria; inventory-only and read-only in POST-H-032-A

promotion_paths.title: Baseline governed agent
minimum_evidence: implementation module exists when status is implemented or implemented-initial
risk_level and policy rule metadata are declared

promotion_paths.title: Model-aware with local provider opt-in
minimum_evidence: local provider health checks are available
provider fallback is explicit and audited
no external API is enabled by default

promotion_paths.title: RAG-aware with citations and insufficient-evidence behavior
minimum_evidence: RAG context pack declares source ids

promotion_paths.title: Memory-aware local opt-in only
minimum_evidence: memory policy is disabled by default
raw prompts and raw outputs are blocked
promotion_paths.blocked_until: POST-H-032-E ADR and memory model close

promotion_paths.title: Tool-calling with allowlist, dry-run and approval binding
minimum_evidence: risk level and side effect are declared
approval binding exists for risky tools

promotion_paths.title: Multiagent supervised handoff without swarm autonomy
minimum_evidence: human checkpoint exists for risky actions
child agents do not inherit tools outside their scope

global_no_go_gates.title: External APIs remain disabled by default
global_no_go_gates.condition: Any agent/provider can call OpenAI/Gemini/Mistral/HF or other external APIs without explicit future ADR and local opt-in.

global_no_go_gates.title: Agent memory remains disabled by default
global_no_go_gates.condition: Any agent persists semantic/session/project memory by default before POST-H-032-E ADR/policy.

global_no_go_gates.title: Source mutation requires explicit approval and dry-run evidence
global_no_go_gates.condition: Any agent can write versioned source without policy decision, scoped approval and dry-run evidence.
global_no_go_gates.verification: source_mutation_allowed_total == 0 or all source mutations require approval

global_no_go_gates.title: Remote execution, connector write and plugin execution remain blocked
global_no_go_gates.condition: Any agent enables remote execution, connector write or plugin code execution in POST-H-032-A.

global_no_go_gates.title: Deterministic gates remain authoritative
global_no_go_gates.condition: LLM/RAG/memory output replaces schema, policy, readiness, claims or quality-gate PASS/BLOCK decisions.
global_no_go_gates.verification: pass_block_decision_must_remain_deterministic agents are marked advisory-only for model use

notes: POST-H-032-A formalizes promotion criteria only; it does not enable LLM, RAG, memory, tools, MCP or multiagent autonomy.
Later POST-H-032 micro-sprints must add their own schemas, tests, negative cases and gates before any promotion becomes executable.
External API provider pilots require ADR and remain disabled by default.
